title: Flood Tunnel Clearance
summary: Scene 11. The first fight: a dead drainage line, a jammed feed and a nest of giant centipedes in a flooded compactor chamber under the old town. Then Vetch at the top with a signature nobody can explain, and each player picks where to spend the night.
goal: The line runs, the nest is dealt with their way, Vetch has asked about Rand, and each player has picked a rest.
howToPlay: Physical first: the smell, the dark, the job. When the nest wakes, keep it fast. **Let them choose how the fight ends.**

intro.where: A disused drainage chamber under the old town, down a ladder from the quay.
intro.readAloud:
The smell reaches you before the light does: standing water that hasn't moved in a long time, and under it something sweeter.

The ladder puts you on a raised platform with a bank of panels, half their lights dead.

Below, a wide floor slopes under black water to a grate the size of a cart wheel, glowing faint amber. Conveyor walkways run along both walls.
intro.landmark: The amber grate in the middle of the flooded floor.

carriesIn.then: They know giant centipedes when they see one: give them the Recall Knowledge result free.
They also know a show of force sends one running.

carriesIn.when: If anyone passed the workshop induction
carriesIn.then: +2 circumstance on panel work: powering the line and overriding the compactor.

carriesIn.when: If anyone qualified on the range
carriesIn.then: +1 circumstance on their first ranged Strike.
They see only what the others' lamps light.

carriesIn.when: If anyone is Fatigued from today

position.note: Under the old landing, down the hatch.

cast.role: Waiting at the top of the ladder with a sheet of paper.

brief.wants: To find out which of them is Rand.

willDiscuss.note: He holds it up: countersigned in green ink over Medical's stamp. Rand, Medical.

willNotDiscuss.topic: Whether the drains were a punishment

voice.register: Clipped and procedural, and for once not sure of himself.
samples: "Nobody called Rand works in Medical. I've asked."

beats.text: Let them look round before anyone touches the panels.
If anyone studies the water before touching anything, offer the check.
The job is in two places. Each player says where they work: the panels, the jam, or waiting at the ladder.

choicePoint.label: The job is in two places. Where do you work?

options.label: The panels: power the line
options.blurb: Up on the dry platform, at the panels.
options.consequence: Out of the water, on the platform, and the panel work is theirs: the workshop's +2 applies here. They are on high ground when the nest wakes.

options.label: The feed: clear the jam
options.blurb: Down on the floor, working the packed feed.
options.consequence: Down on the flooded floor in dim light, working the jam. When the nest wakes they are standing in difficult terrain, near the grate.

options.label: Wait at the ladder
options.blurb: Hold at the top and come down when you like.
options.consequence: They wait at the ladder and can come down any time. The job doesn't wait for them.

beats.text: The job, part one: get power back to the drainage line from the panels. Runs alongside clearing the jam.
The job, part two: clear the jam in the compactor feed, down on the floor. Runs alongside powering the line.
beats.readAloud: The feed is packed solid with whatever the old town has been putting down its drains, pressed into something with a grain to it. It comes apart if you work it in the right place.

beats.text: The machinery wakes the nest <trig id="nest-wakes"/>. Six giant centipedes come up out of the water around the grate.
beats.direction: Fast and physical. The flooded floor is difficult terrain in dim light; the walkways are dry high ground.
beats.note:
Do: Ask how they want it to end, and back their answer. Each ending earns full XP.
If someone won't fight: Holding a walkway or working the panels is real work.
If it goes badly: Once half are down, the rest break for the grate.

options.label: Kill the nest
options.blurb: Fight until the last centipede is dead.
options.consequence: A straight fight, until the last centipede is dead.

options.label: Drive them off
options.blurb: Hurt them until the rest run.
options.consequence: Losses and a show of force send the rest down the grate.

options.label: Use the room
options.consequence: The compactor, the grate or the water does it.

beats.text: If the compactor is closing in, anyone at the north panels can spend their turn overriding it.
beats.note: Do: Say plainly that it's as useful as an attack: it buys everyone on the floor their ground back.

beats.text: They climb out. Vetch <trig id="vetch-at-the-top"/> is waiting with their requisition, countersigned. Read it, then let him ask.
beats.readAloud:
Vetch is waiting at the top of the ladder with a lamp and a sheet of paper. It's your requisition for the vial, countersigned in green ink over Medical's stamp: Rand, Medical.

"Which one of you is Rand?"
beats.note:
If they don't know: "Nobody called Rand works in Medical. I've asked." He folds it away and dismisses them.
Secret: Rand is Shucks's own right hand, loose in the city. It signed tonight, from Shucks's desk. Nobody knows, Shucks included.

outro.endsWhen: Vetch has dismissed them, and each player has picked a rest.

tracks.why: If the fight, or the climb out, pulled them together.

transition.line: Dismissed. Each of them picks where to spend the night.

departure.question: Where do you spend the night?

destinations.label: The General Hospital
destinations.blurb: A ward bed and a night nurse. Restores all your HP, and nothing else.

destinations.label: An early night
destinations.blurb: Your own bunk in the overflow block. Restores half your HP.

destinations.label: The Bathhouse
destinations.blurb: The big public bath. Restores half your HP, and gives you temporary HP.

destinations.label: The Roof
destinations.blurb: A flat roof, and the whole city lit up across the water. Restores half your HP.

destinations.label: The Shrine Gate
destinations.blurb: A small shrine on a street corner. Restores a quarter of your HP, and you draw a fortune.

destinations.label: The Crew Mess
destinations.blurb: The repair crews' bar behind the dry dock. Restores a quarter of your HP. Somebody might stand you a drink.

destinations.label: The Card Game
destinations.blurb: A game in Row F that never stops. Restores a quarter of your HP, and there's a pot to win.

destinations.label: The Rumour Mill
destinations.blurb: Second-termers sitting up after lights-out. Restores a quarter of your HP, and you hear things.

destinations.label: The Night Observer
destinations.blurb: The Met Office roof, read every hour of the night. Restores a quarter of your HP, and you learn tomorrow's weather.

destinations.label: The Night Shift
destinations.blurb: No. 1 Machine Shop, where the night crew keep working. Restores a quarter of your HP, and pays.

destinations.label: Somewhere new
destinations.blurb: You don't know what's there, or what it gives. That's the point.

outro.onwards: The night's rests, each player their own. Episode One ends there.
writeDown: How they ended the fight, and who did what.
Who has a theory about Rand.

position.note: Leaving the old landing for the night.

temptations.text: What's actually down here, before anyone makes a noise?

reactionPrompts.text: The first fight: pace, and whether the walkways got used.
How they chose to end it.
"Which one of you is Rand?" landing.

notes: The episode's real climax. The centipedes are animals: nothing about them points at anything else. The compactor cycle is optional; the fight works without it. The Paper Lantern isn't offered as a rest yet because it isn't on the map.
